Rachel Fetty Anderson

DEM candidate for U.S. Senator, West Virginia · Challenger

Attorney (public interest / pro bono)

Rachel Fetty Anderson is a Democrat from Morgantown, a public interest attorney, and a former member of the Morgantown City Council (2017–2021). She won the five-candidate Democratic primary for U.S. Senate on May 12, 2026. In the November 3, 2026 general election she faces incumbent Republican Shelley Moore Capito and Constitution Party candidate S. Marshall Wilson.

Where Anderson stands

Taxes
Criticizes the 2025 'One Big Beautiful Bill Act.' She argues that while it cut taxes on tips, many people who seek Medicaid or Affordable Care Act subsidies lost their health coverage.
Energy prices and permitting reform
Says the entire rise in diesel prices over the past year comes from war and tariffs.
Iran
Says the U.S. should not go to war in the Middle East for oil and that leaders should have consulted veterans before acting.
Federal spending accountability
Proposes requiring audits of the Defense Department and of foreign and corporate payments, investments and gifts to all elected officials.
Health care
Says West Virginia and the nation need universal health care.
